title: BEST INFINITE CREEPER FARM 1.21! Minecraft Tutorial In 1 Minute!
description:
In This Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make the next generation of creeper farming inspired by the Gnembon module. It uses 3 combined new methods and the same platform pattern from Gnembon Farm, which is perfect for this module and makes it extremely powerful. The key difference is that there is no clock, and once mobs are spawned, they will be triggered toward the edge of platforms, making the farm 200% up to 299% more efficient in Minecraft!

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
